title: Bernasconi 2018 preprint · Trunk PPS with intracranial EEG
citation: Bernasconi et al. (2018). Audio-tactile and peripersonal space processing around the trunk in human parietal and temporal cortex: an intracranial EEG study. bioRxiv v1.
notes: Preprint study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.cohort: Six patients with clinically indicated intracranial recording for epilepsy surgery evaluation.
published_method.audio: Front-to-body 3 s recorded white-noise approach starting at 2 m, nominal speed 0.66 m/s, played through Etymotic ER-4P earphones. Binaural recording used two eight-speaker arrays and a 3Dio microphone.
published_method.touch: Three 100 ms commands to a 312-101 shaftless vibration motor on upper sternum, controlled by Arduino and ExpyVR.
published_method.timing_note: Pulse onsets for paired trials are relative to sound onset and for tactile-only trials relative to the silent trial start. Interpret the third printed value as milliseconds using the 3 s stimulus duration. Reported nominal distances label categories.
published_method.outcome: Patient attends to sound and vibration with eyes closed, without an overt response. Analyze local field potentials, nonlinear integration, distance dependence and tactile habituation.

stimulus_type.value: Looming white noise presented as a binaural recording.

soa_table.source: bioRxiv v1 pp. 4–5, Material and apparatus and Procedures; Cerebral Cortex issue pp. 3387–3389
soa_table.gap: Both preprint and journal print 2500m or 2500 m. Interpreted as 2500 ms because the earlier delays are 500 and 1500 ms, the trial is 3000 ms, and 0.66 m/s from 2 m gives about 0.35 m at 2.5 s, near the reported 0.3 m. Actual event schedule and measured onset are unverified.

baseline_strategy.value: Use matched T and A trials for additive comparison. For active-electrode screening use uncorrected LFPs and compare prestimulus with poststimulus activity. Follow-up response contrasts use baseline correction. T-only pulse-order control checks anticipation and habituation.

implementation_gaps: Requires three within-trial pulses with controlled physical latency and jitter and synchronized iEEG event codes.
Original binaural recording, sound level, exact pulse schedules and physical output calibration are unavailable.
